notes.title: Patch 1.10
notes.notes:
Happy new year, Roaches! :D

Patch 1.10 with lots of changes!

[u][b]Balance[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] fire planes base damage increased to 150% (was 120%).
[*] ice plane maximum damage decreased to 250% (was 350%).
[*] freezing maximum damage decreased to 250% (was 500%).
[/list]

[u][b]Quality of Life[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Steam Overlay can now be activated during map selection and during a paused level.
[*] when player 2 uses a skill that can't be used (no paper / occupied space), the skill will now remain selected.
[*] player 2 selection areas are now on a lower layer, meaning player 1 can now hover over towers and enemies to check on them even if player 2 is using a skill.
[/list]

[u][b]Bug fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] bosses that can't be hit by planes should no longer be able to be hit by area effects.
[*] player 2 selection areas will now turn invisible when switching levels.
[*] player 2 can no longer build in unbuildable areas in chapter 8.
[*] tower life behaved oddly in multiplayer. Should be fixed now.
[*] the time announcement is no longer above the boss name, when hovering over the boss life bar.
[*] music and beat now restart together when entering a boss fight.
[*] ultimate star upgrades can now be selected properly and have the correct image displayed.
[/list]

[u][b]Minor fixes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] fixed typo in German achievement description for beating chapter 8.
[*] chain lightning description fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.04
notes.notes:
Heya roaches!

Here some new changes and fixes:

[b]Changes[/b]
- the boss in chapter 4 was too tough, especially in multiplayer and on later difficulties. So enemy life in that level is decreased by 28.56%. I hope that helps!

[b]Fixes[/b]
- achievement popup windows can now always be clicked away. Even when player two is active...
- when player 2 buys the enemy speed degrade, it will properly show their level and not the one from player 1
- soaps will no longer be pushed back when hit during their attack phase
- when losing a level, You will no longer see the celebration screen for a split second
- when exiting a level in chapter 8, all particles will now be properly removed


Keep on defending those lanes ;)
Great day to all!
- Mike

notes.title: Patch 1.03
notes.notes:
Guten Tag fellow roaches! ;)

A new update fixing various things. Here the list:

- clicking on items in the win screen will now longer destroy the game
- during chapter 8 towers will now attack earlier
- the English description for the freeze duration skill is now fixed
- boss enemies should now properly die if interrupted during the dying phase 
- English achievement descriptions fixed
- freeze damage is now properly depending on whether a tower shot the freezing plane or the player
- when player 2 invests the enemy life degrade, it now shows the proper level of the upgrade

notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
Cheers fellow roaches!

Here the patchnotes for version 1.02, fixing some smaller issues:
- cutlery should no longer fall over twice when taking damage while dying
- seedolins should no longer turn invisible when slowed
- enemies can now *actually* no longer be frozen while swimming
- changed a word in the Swabian loading screen

notes.title: Patch 0.5.1 for the demo
notes.notes:
Heya paper plane throwers!
Here the patch notes for the first demo patch:

- fixed some typos

- the bestiary pages containing enemies not included in the demo now have their own page number

- completing level 10 will now show the demo end screen instead of locking the game

- fixed error messages for both players when launching attacks that can't be afforded or are blocked by already existing catapults


I'm still working on the overlay fix. Keep inviting Your friends in the main menu ;)
Happy hunting!

- Mike
